home.title: Welcome to the portfolio of Watcharakorn Chaveewongprateep
home.title2: This portfolio presents a curated collection of projects I have created and developed during 2024-2025. Each work embodies my identity, perspective, and creative process, showcasing a diverse range of projects crafted with dedication, attention to detail, and a passion for innovation.
home.title3: Thank you sincerely for taking the time to view my work.

project1.des: The POS project was developed to improve the dining experience in restaurants by reducing unnecessary communication between customers and staff. Customers can place their orders directly through a QR code and a web application, while the restaurant can manage menus, orders, and billing in one integrated system. This approach saves time, minimizes errors, and enhances convenience for both sides.
project1.infolist1: Covers essential functions for restaurant operations, from customers to staff
project1.infolist2: Allows customers to order directly via QR Code without relying on staff
project1.infolist3: Supports multi-language menus, catering to international customers
project1.infolist4: Accommodates buffet-style service for flexible usage
project1.infolist5: Real-time order management reduces errors and speeds up service
project1.infolist6: Restaurant staff can manage the menu, adding or removing items independently
project1.infolist7: Automatically calculates VAT and service charges for accurate billing

project2.des: The Zombie Outbreak project was created from personal interest in designing a board game to play with friends. It was inspired by Werewolf but redesigned with unique roles and custom gameplay mechanics. Traditionally, this type of game requires a dedicated Director to manage the flow, but this project eliminates that need by making the system itself act as the Director, ensuring a smoother game experience.
project2.infolist2: Handles countdowns and role actions, including Police, Doctor, Hunter, Inspector, and Alpha Zombie
project2.infolist3: Eliminates the need for a game director, unlike traditional board games
project2.infolist4: Synchronizes gameplay data and results to reduce errors and provide a smooth gaming experience
project2.info2: Technically, the project was built using React for the frontend, Node.js/Express for the backend, MySQL for database management, and Docker to maintain consistency and stability in real-world deployment.

project3.des: The Birthday Project was developed as a creative way to design a small website that could be gifted to friends or loved ones on their birthdays. The site was designed to display heartfelt birthday wishes with a bright and cheerful theme, aiming to create a memorable and enjoyable experience.
project3.infolist2: Developed with React for a modern and responsive user interface
project3.infolist3: Deployed via Firebase Hosting for easy access
project3.infolist5: Includes interactive UI elements, such as greetings and small animations, to enhance user engagement

project4.des: The Room Rental project was developed to address the common problem that searching for rental rooms is often time-consuming and inconvenient, as tenants usually need to visit the rooms in person. This can be inconvenient and waste time. The system was therefore designed to help tenants find rooms that match their requirements more easily, while also allowing property owners to present information more clearly. Currently, the system supports listings only in Phuket province. This project was completed as part of a Vocational Certificate graduation requirement.
project4.infolist1: Displays rental room details, including price, location, and contact information
project4.infolist2: Includes a search function to allow users to filter listings quickly based on their preferences
project4.infolist3: Includes a ‘like’ feature to save for later viewing

project5.des: The Bucketlist project was created from my personal interest in wanting to make a bucket list to use and share with my partner. I developed the Bucketlist web application to allow couples or friends to create lists of things they want to do together and invite others to join in, making it a fun and engaging experience.
project5.infolist1: Google login for convenience and security
project5.infolist2: Displays progress percentage for each bucket list item
project5.infolist3: Invite friends to collaborate on bucket lists
project5.infolist4: Full item management: add, delete, and edit freely
project5.infolist5: Track item status, e.g., In Progress and Completed
project5.infolist6: Share private invitation links for easy access to bucket lists
project5.info2: In terms of technology, this system is developed using Next.js for the frontend, Node.js/Express for the backend, and MySQL for database management. The entire setup is managed through Docker to ensure consistency in development and production, making deployment and usage straightforward and efficient.
